name: codex-desktop-relay
description: Receive and dispatch Codex thread messages across machines through the shared Business MCP control plane.

interface.shortDescription: Send and receive Codex thread messages between machines.
interface.longDescription: Codex Desktop Relay connects each Codex Desktop machine to a Business MCP queue, dispatches queued prompts into the machine's shared sidecar, and reports completion without opening the local app-server to the network.
defaultPrompt: Show Codex relay status on this machine.
Dispatch a prompt to a local Codex thread.
Send a message to another Codex machine.
